clause: On-device ML selection: object select, Select Subject, Select Sky [STU-RAS-018,STU-RAS-019]

scope.summary: Implement the on-device ML selection tools producing StudioSelectionSet, running locally with no cloud dependency per STU-RAS-019: object select (auto-selects a detected object under hover/rectangle/lasso with multi-part component selection and optional matting), one-command Select Subject (dominant subject(s), recordable into a macro/batch), and one-command Select Sky. Inference runs in studio-engine through the RasterEngine boundary; any cloud-accelerated variant is an optional §10 adapter, never a core dependency.
acceptance_criteria: inference in studio-engine; cloud variant optional; results are StudioSelectionSet
proof_targets: offline on-device Select-Subject runtime + no-network assertion
expected_tests: live: Select Subject runs on-device (no network) and produces a plausible subject selection on a test image; object-select isolates a hovered object
test: no cloud/account call in the code path (offline harness); inference executes in studio-engine
argus: selection snapshot + receipt of the ML run

target_entries: Studio / Raster / Object, Subject & Sky selection (on-device)

risk_if_missed: ML selection becomes a cloud dependency, violating local-first; core selection workflow breaks offline.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
